svg.title: Active Learning · eye-tracking (2026)
svg.desc: Active Learning: eye-tracking prediction with a plain camera, ResNet-18 and active learning.
svg.text: active learning · personal study, data recorded as a team of 3 · ENSIM
Predicts where a person looks on the screen with a plain computer camera (ResNet-18),
choosing the images worth training on through active learning.
Clustering L2 reaches the lowest error (MAE 0.0331 vs 0.0362), yet random selection
